id-20261029-news-2.title: Frequent Cabinet Reshuffles and Policy Certainty: Why the Business Community Remains Cautious in Assessing the Political Climate

segments.src: Survei ICCI Kontan edisi Oktober 2026 mencatat Indeks Politik Nasional di level 2,89.
segments.tr: The October 2026 edition of the Kontan ICCI Survey recorded the National Political Index at the level of 2.89.

segments.src: Angka ini berada di bawah garis netral, dan posisi tersebut bertahan selama tiga kuartal berturut-turut.
segments.tr: This figure is below the neutral line, and this position has persisted for three consecutive quarters.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha, hasil ini bukan sekadar statistik.
segments.tr: For business actors, this result is not merely a statistic.

segments.src: Ia mencerminkan cara dunia usaha membaca arah kebijakan, stabilitas pengambilan keputusan, dan seberapa jauh aturan main dapat dijadikan pegangan.
segments.tr: It reflects how the business world reads policy directions, decision-making stability, and the extent to which the rules of the game can be used as a guide.

segments.src: Tulisan ini membahas mengapa pergantian menteri dan konsistensi regulasi sering muncul dalam percakapan pengusaha, serta bagaimana kedua faktor itu dapat memengaruhi keputusan investasi dan ekspansi.
segments.tr: This article discusses why ministerial changes and regulatory consistency frequently appear in business conversations, and how these two factors can influence investment and expansion decisions.

segments.src: Pembahasan bersifat analitis dan tidak menilai pihak tertentu.
segments.tr: The discussion is analytical and does not judge any specific party.

segments.src: ## Apa yang dimaksud dengan indeks di bawah garis netral
segments.tr: ## What is meant by an index below the neutral line

segments.src: Indeks persepsi seperti ini disusun dari penilaian responden, umumnya kalangan pelaku usaha dan pengamat, terhadap kondisi politik.
segments.tr: Perception indices like this are compiled from the assessments of respondents, generally business actors and observers, regarding political conditions.

segments.src: Nilai di atas garis netral menandakan penilaian yang cenderung positif, sedangkan nilai di bawahnya menandakan sikap yang lebih hati-hati.
segments.tr: Values above the neutral line indicate a tendency toward a positive assessment, while values below it indicate a more cautious stance.

segments.src: Hal yang patut dicermati adalah durasinya.
segments.tr: A point worth noting is the duration.

segments.src: Satu kuartal di bawah garis netral dapat dipicu peristiwa sesaat.
segments.tr: A single quarter below the neutral line can be triggered by momentary events.

segments.src: Tiga kuartal berturut-turut menunjukkan kehati-hatian yang lebih menetap, sehingga lebih mungkin berkaitan dengan faktor struktural seperti kejelasan arah kebijakan.
segments.tr: Three consecutive quarters indicate a more persistent caution, making it more likely related to structural factors such as the clarity of policy direction.

segments.src: Perlu diingat pula bahwa indeks ini mengukur persepsi, bukan data kinerja ekonomi.
segments.tr: It should also be remembered that this index measures perception, not economic performance data.

segments.src: Persepsi tetap penting karena keputusan bisnis banyak dipengaruhi oleh ekspektasi.
segments.tr: Perception remains important because business decisions are heavily influenced by expectations.

segments.src: ## Reshuffle kabinet dari sudut pandang dunia usaha
segments.tr: ## Cabinet reshuffles from the perspective of the business world

segments.src: Perombakan kabinet adalah hak prerogatif presiden dan bisa dilakukan untuk berbagai alasan yang sah, misalnya penyegaran kinerja atau penyesuaian prioritas pemerintah.
segments.tr: Cabinet reshuffles are the prerogative of the president and can be carried out for various legitimate reasons, such as performance refreshment or adjustments to government priorities.

segments.src: Namun, dari sisi pelaku usaha, frekuensi pergantian membawa beberapa konsekuensi praktis:
segments.tr: However, from the perspective of business actors, the frequency of changes brings several practical consequences:

segments.src: - **Kesinambungan program.** Program yang sedang berjalan bisa ditinjau ulang oleh pejabat baru, sehingga jadwal dan prioritasnya berubah.
segments.tr: - **Program continuity.** Ongoing programs can be reviewed by new officials, changing their schedules and priorities.

segments.src: - **Hubungan kerja dengan regulator.** Komunikasi dan kesepahaman yang sudah terbangun dengan kementerian tertentu perlu dibangun kembali.
segments.tr: - **Working relationships with regulators.** Communication and understanding already built with certain ministries need to be rebuilt.

segments.src: - **Interpretasi aturan.** Peraturan pelaksana, surat edaran, atau praktik perizinan dapat berubah mengikuti pandangan pimpinan baru.
segments.tr: - **Rule interpretation.** Implementing regulations, circular letters, or licensing practices can change following the views of new leadership.

segments.src: - **Sinyal arah kebijakan.** Pergantian yang berulang dapat dibaca sebagai tanda arah belum sepenuhnya mantap, meskipun tidak selalu demikian.
segments.tr: - **Policy direction signals.** Repeated changes can be read as a sign that the direction is not yet fully settled, although this is not always the case.

segments.src: ## Kepastian kebijakan sebagai pertimbangan utama investasi
segments.tr: ## Policy certainty as a primary investment consideration

segments.src: Investor, baik domestik maupun asing, menimbang banyak hal: ukuran pasar, biaya, tenaga kerja, infrastruktur, dan risiko.
segments.tr: Investors, both domestic and foreign, weigh many things: market size, costs, labor, infrastructure, and risks.

segments.src: Di antara semuanya, kepastian kebijakan sering menjadi faktor penentu karena memengaruhi perhitungan jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Among them all, policy certainty often becomes a determining factor because it affects long-term calculations.

segments.src: Proyek manufaktur, energi, properti, atau logistik umumnya membutuhkan horizon pengembalian bertahun-tahun.
segments.tr: Manufacturing, energy, property, or logistics projects generally require a return horizon of many years.

segments.src: Jika aturan terkait perizinan, insentif pajak, kandungan lokal, atau tata niaga dapat berubah di tengah jalan, perusahaan cenderung menambahkan margin risiko pada hitungannya.
segments.tr: If rules related to licensing, tax incentives, local content, or trade arrangements can change midway, companies tend to add a risk margin to their calculations.

segments.src: Akibatnya, sebagian proyek yang semula layak dapat ditunda atau dikurangi skalanya.
segments.tr: As a result, some projects that were initially viable may be delayed or scaled down.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, dunia usaha tidak selalu menolak aturan yang ketat.
segments.tr: In other words, the business world does not always reject strict rules.

segments.src: Yang lebih dicari adalah aturan yang jelas, dapat diprediksi, dan diterapkan secara konsisten.
segments.tr: What is sought instead are rules that are clear, predictable, and applied consistently.

segments.src: ## Dampak pada keputusan ekspansi
segments.tr: ## Impact on expansion decisions

segments.src: Di tingkat perusahaan, sikap hati-hati biasanya tampak dalam beberapa bentuk:
segments.tr: At the corporate level, a cautious attitude usually appears in several forms:

segments.src: 1. **Menunda belanja modal** sampai ada kejelasan regulasi.
segments.tr: 1. **Delaying capital expenditure** until there is regulatory clarity.

segments.src: 2. **Memilih ekspansi bertahap** dibandingkan komitmen besar sekaligus.
segments.tr: 2. **Choosing gradual expansion** compared to large commitments all at once.

segments.src: 3. **Menjaga likuiditas lebih tebal** sebagai penyangga ketidakpastian.
segments.tr: 3. **Maintaining thicker liquidity** as a buffer against uncertainty.

segments.src: 4. **Memprioritaskan efisiensi** daripada penambahan kapasitas.
segments.tr: 4. **Prioritizing efficiency** rather than capacity additions.

segments.src: 5. **Menunggu momentum** sebelum merekrut atau meluncurkan lini produk baru.
segments.tr: 5. **Waiting for momentum** before hiring or launching new product lines.

segments.src: Bagi usaha kecil dan menengah, dampaknya bisa berbeda.
segments.tr: For small and medium enterprises, the impact can be different.

segments.src: UMKM biasanya tidak menggantungkan keputusan pada satu regulasi besar, tetapi tetap merasakan efek tidak langsung, seperti perubahan permintaan, harga bahan baku, atau prosedur perizinan.
segments.tr: MSMEs usually do not hinge decisions on a single major regulation, but still feel indirect effects, such as changes in demand, raw material prices, or licensing procedures.

segments.src: ## Apa yang bisa memperbaiki persepsi
segments.tr: ## What can improve perceptions

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang kerap diusulkan kalangan pengamat dan asosiasi usaha antara lain:
segments.tr: Some steps frequently proposed by observers and business associations include:

segments.src: - **Konsultasi publik yang memadai** sebelum aturan penting diterbitkan.
segments.tr: - **Adequate public consultation** before important rules are issued.

segments.src: - **Masa transisi yang jelas** ketika ada perubahan regulasi.
segments.tr: - **Clear transition periods** when regulatory changes occur.

segments.src: - **Penyederhanaan dan harmonisasi aturan** lintas kementerian dan antara pusat dan daerah.
segments.tr: - **Simplification and harmonization of rules** across ministries and between the central and regional governments.

segments.src: - **Komunikasi kebijakan yang konsisten** agar pasar tidak menafsirkan sinyal secara berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: - **Consistent policy communication** so the market does not interpret signals differently.

segments.src: - **Kesinambungan program prioritas** meskipun terjadi pergantian pejabat.
segments.tr: - **Continuity of priority programs** even when official changes happen.

segments.src: Langkah-langkah ini tidak berarti membatasi ruang pemerintah untuk mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: These steps do not mean limiting the government's room to make decisions.

segments.src: Tujuannya adalah mengurangi ketidakpastian yang tidak perlu.
segments.tr: The goal is to reduce unnecessary uncertainty.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca hasil survei dengan proporsional
segments.tr: ## How to read survey results proportionally

segments.src: Beberapa catatan agar angka 2,89 dipahami secara seimbang:
segments.tr: Some notes so that the 2.89 figure is understood in a balanced way:

segments.src: - Survei persepsi memiliki keterbatasan metodologis, seperti jumlah dan latar belakang responden.
segments.tr: - Perception surveys have methodological limitations, such as the number and background of respondents.

segments.src: - Indeks politik hanya satu dari banyak indikator. Investasi juga dipengaruhi suku bunga, nilai tukar, kondisi global, dan permintaan domestik.
segments.tr: - The political index is only one of many indicators. Investment is also influenced by interest rates, exchange rates, global conditions, and domestic demand.

segments.src: - Nilai di bawah garis netral menunjukkan kehati-hatian, bukan otomatis pesimisme total atau berhentinya aktivitas usaha.
segments.tr: - Values below the neutral line indicate caution, not automatically total pessimism or the cessation of business activity.

segments.src: - Persepsi dapat berubah bila ada langkah nyata yang memperkuat kepastian.
segments.tr: - Perceptions can change if there are real steps that strengthen certainty.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Indeks Politik Nasional 2,89 dalam survei ICCI Kontan Oktober 2026 menggambarkan dunia usaha yang masih menunggu kejelasan.
segments.tr: The National Political Index of 2.89 in the October 2026 Kontan survey depicts a business world that is still waiting for clarity.

segments.src: Pergantian menteri yang berulang dan konsistensi aturan menjadi dua faktor yang sering dikaitkan dengan sikap tersebut, karena keduanya menyentuh hal yang paling dibutuhkan investor: kemampuan memperkirakan masa depan.
segments.tr: Repeated ministerial changes and rule consistency become two factors often associated with this attitude, because both touch upon what investors need most: the ability to forecast the future.

segments.src: Bagi pembaca yang menjalankan usaha, memantau perkembangan regulasi, menyiapkan skenario, dan menjaga fleksibilitas keuangan adalah langkah yang masuk akal.
segments.tr: For readers running businesses, monitoring regulatory developments, preparing scenarios, and maintaining financial flexibility are sensible steps.

segments.src: Sementara itu, perkembangan indeks pada kuartal-kuartal berikutnya akan menunjukkan apakah kehati-hatian ini mereda atau berlanjut.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the development of the index in subsequent quarters will show whether this caution subsides or continues.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat investasi atau hukum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is of general information and not investment or legal advice.

segments.src: Untuk keputusan bisnis tertentu, rujuklah data resmi dan konsultasikan dengan profesional yang berkompeten.*
segments.tr: For specific business decisions, refer to official data and consult with competent professionals.*

id-20261029-news-3.title: Danantara and SOE Management: What the Public Needs to Monitor Regarding Governance, Transparency, and State Fund Risks

segments.src: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara, atau Danantara, dibentuk untuk mengelola aset dan investasi badan usaha milik negara (BUMN) secara terkonsolidasi.
segments.tr: The Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency, or Danantara, was established to manage the assets and investments of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in a consolidated manner.

segments.src: Skalanya besar, sehingga pertanyaan tentang cara kerja, pengawasan, dan keterbukaannya menyangkut kepentingan banyak orang.
segments.tr: Its scale is significant, so questions about its operations, oversight, and openness concern many people.

segments.src: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan netral.
segments.tr: This article is informative and neutral.

segments.src: Tujuannya membantu pembaca memahami kerangka dasarnya dan menyiapkan alat sederhana untuk menilai investasi yang memakai dana publik.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to help readers understand the basic framework and prepare simple tools to assess investments that use public funds.

segments.src: > Catatan: aturan dan struktur Danantara dapat berubah seiring revisi regulasi dan kebijakan turunan. Periksa selalu sumber resmi pemerintah, peraturan terbaru, dan laporan lembaga pengawas sebelum mengambil kesimpulan.
segments.tr: > Note: Danantara's rules and structure may change as regulations and derivative policies are revised. Always check official government sources, the latest regulations, and reports from oversight bodies before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: ## Apa itu Danantara dan mengapa penting?
segments.tr: ## What is Danantara and why is it important?

segments.src: Danantara diperkenalkan pemerintah pada awal 2025 sebagai lembaga pengelola investasi yang menaungi sejumlah BUMN besar.
segments.tr: Danantara was introduced by the government in early 2025 as an investment management agency that oversees a number of major SOEs.

segments.src: Gagasan utamanya adalah mengonsolidasikan aset dan dividen BUMN agar dapat dikelola lebih terpusat, dengan harapan mendorong investasi di sektor-sektor strategis.
segments.tr: The main idea is to consolidate SOE assets and dividends so they can be managed more centrally, with the hope of boosting investment in strategic sectors.

segments.src: Model serupa ada di sejumlah negara, yang biasa disebut dana kekayaan negara (sovereign wealth fund).
segments.tr: Similar models exist in a number of countries, commonly referred to as sovereign wealth funds.

segments.src: Alasan publik perlu memperhatikannya sederhana.
segments.tr: The reason the public needs to pay attention is simple.

segments.src: BUMN dimiliki negara, dan negara dibiayai oleh pajak, penerimaan negara bukan pajak, serta kekayaan alam.
segments.tr: SOEs are owned by the state, and the state is financed by taxes, non-tax state revenue, and natural resources.

segments.src: Keputusan investasi di lembaga sebesar ini bisa berdampak pada layanan publik, lapangan kerja, harga barang dan jasa, serta kondisi keuangan negara dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Investment decisions in an agency of this size can impact public services, employment, the prices of goods and services, and the state's financial condition in the long term.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana cara kerjanya secara umum?
segments.tr: ## How does it work in general?

segments.src: Secara garis besar, struktur lembaga semacam ini memiliki beberapa lapisan:
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, the structure of such an agency has several layers:

segments.src: - **Badan pengelola utama**: menetapkan arah strategis, kebijakan investasi, dan tata kelola.
segments.tr: - **Main management body**: sets strategic direction, investment policies, and governance.

segments.src: - **Entitas operasional**: biasanya terpisah untuk fungsi pengelolaan aset dan fungsi investasi, agar peran dan tanggung jawabnya jelas.
segments.tr: - **Operational entities**: usually separated for asset management functions and investment functions, so that roles and responsibilities are clear.

segments.src: - **BUMN dan anak usaha**: perusahaan yang tetap menjalankan bisnis sehari-hari, seperti perbankan, energi, telekomunikasi, dan infrastruktur.
segments.tr: - **SOEs and subsidiaries**: companies that continue to run day-to-day business, such as banking, energy, telecommunications, and infrastructure.

segments.src: - **Mitra investasi**: investor domestik atau asing yang dapat bekerja sama dalam proyek tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Investment partners**: domestic or foreign investors who can collaborate on specific projects.

segments.src: Sumber dana dan imbal hasilnya umumnya berasal dari dividen BUMN, hasil pengelolaan aset, serta kemitraan investasi.
segments.tr: Sources of funds and their returns generally come from SOE dividends, asset management results, and investment partnerships.

segments.src: Detail struktur resmi sebaiknya dibaca langsung pada undang-undang BUMN beserta perubahannya, peraturan pemerintah, dan situs resmi lembaga.
segments.tr: Details of the official structure should be read directly in the SOE law and its amendments, government regulations, and the agency's official website.

segments.src: ## Siapa yang mengawasi?
segments.tr: ## Who provides oversight?

segments.src: Pengawasan pada lembaga publik biasanya berlapis.
segments.tr: Oversight of public agencies is usually layered.

segments.src: Warga dapat mengenali pihak-pihak berikut:
segments.tr: Citizens can identify the following parties:

segments.src: 1. **Dewan pengawas dan komisaris**: pengawasan internal atas kebijakan dan kinerja manajemen.
segments.tr: 1. **Supervisory board and commissioners**: internal oversight of management policies and performance.

segments.src: 2. **Auditor independen**: audit laporan keuangan tahunan oleh kantor akuntan publik.
segments.tr: 2. **Independent auditors**: annual financial statement audits by public accounting firms.

segments.src: 3. **Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan (BPK)**: memeriksa pengelolaan keuangan negara. Cakupan kewenangan pemeriksaan terhadap entitas seperti Danantara menjadi pokok pembahasan para ahli, sehingga perlu dicek ketentuan terbaru.
segments.tr: 3. **Audit Board of Indonesia (BPK)**: examines the management of state finances. The scope of audit authority over entities like Danantara is a subject of discussion among experts, so the latest provisions need to be checked.

segments.src: 4. **Lembaga penegak hukum dan antikorupsi**: KPK, kejaksaan, dan kepolisian bekerja bila ada dugaan pelanggaran hukum.
segments.tr: 4. **Law enforcement and anti-corruption agencies**: the KPK, the Attorney General's Office, and the police work if there are allegations of legal violations.

segments.src: 5. **DPR**: fungsi pengawasan politik, termasuk rapat dengar pendapat dan pembahasan anggaran.
segments.tr: 5. **DPR (House of Representatives)**: political oversight function, including hearings and budget discussions.

segments.src: 6. **Otoritas sektor**: misalnya OJK dan otoritas bursa untuk perusahaan yang tercatat di pasar modal.
segments.tr: 6. **Sectoral authorities**: for example, the OJK (Financial Services Authority) and stock exchange authorities for companies listed on the capital market.

segments.src: 7. **Publik, media, dan masyarakat sipil**: pengawasan melalui akses informasi, pemberitaan, dan kajian independen.
segments.tr: 7. **Public, media, and civil society**: oversight through access to information, news coverage, and independent studies.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang sering muncul dalam diskusi publik: apakah kerugian investasi dapat dikategorikan sebagai kerugian negara, bagaimana prinsip *business judgment rule* diterapkan, dan sejauh mana pemeriksaan eksternal dapat menjangkau.
segments.tr: Questions that often arise in public discussion: can investment losses be categorized as state losses, how is the *business judgment rule* applied, and to what extent can external examinations reach.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan mengikuti penjelasan resmi dan analisis ahli hukum yang kredibel, bukan potongan opini di media sosial.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to follow official explanations and analyses from credible legal experts, not snippets of opinions on social media.

segments.src: ## Indikator transparansi yang bisa dipakai warga
segments.tr: ## Transparency indicators that citizens can use

segments.src: Anda tidak perlu menjadi analis keuangan untuk menilai keterbukaan sebuah lembaga.
segments.tr: You don't need to be a financial analyst to assess the openness of an agency.

segments.src: Berikut daftar periksa praktis:
segments.tr: Here is a practical checklist:

segments.src: - **Laporan tahunan dan laporan keuangan teraudit** yang dipublikasikan tepat waktu dan mudah diunduh.
segments.tr: - **Annual reports and audited financial statements** that are published on time and easy to download.

segments.src: - **Opini auditor**: apakah wajar tanpa pengecualian, dan adakah catatan penting dari auditor.
segments.tr: - **Auditor's opinion**: whether it is unqualified, and whether there are important notes from the auditor.

segments.src: - **Kebijakan investasi tertulis**: sektor yang disasar, batas risiko, dan kriteria pemilihan proyek.
segments.tr: - **Written investment policy**: targeted sectors, risk limits, and project selection criteria.

segments.src: - **Daftar investasi utama**: nilai, mitra, dan status proyek, sejauh tidak mengganggu kerahasiaan komersial yang sah.
segments.tr: - **List of major investments**: value, partners, and project status, as long as it does not interfere with legitimate commercial confidentiality.

segments.src: - **Pengelolaan konflik kepentingan**: aturan benturan kepentingan, rangkap jabatan, dan pelaporan harta kekayaan pejabat.
segments.tr: - **Conflict of interest management**: rules on conflicts of interest, concurrent positions, and reporting of officials' wealth.

segments.src: - **Proses pengangkatan pimpinan**: kriteria, rekam jejak, dan mekanisme seleksi yang jelas.
segments.tr: - **Leadership appointment process**: clear criteria, track record, and selection mechanisms.

segments.src: - **Indikator kinerja**: imbal hasil, rasio utang, dan realisasi dibanding target.
segments.tr: - **Performance indicators**: returns, debt ratios, and realization compared to targets.

segments.src: - **Saluran pengaduan**: mekanisme whistleblowing dan tindak lanjutnya.
segments.tr: - **Complaint channels**: whistleblowing mechanisms and their follow-up.

segments.src: - **Akses informasi publik**: kesediaan menjawab permohonan sesuai Undang-Undang Keterbukaan Informasi Publik.
segments.tr: - **Public information access**: willingness to respond to requests in accordance with the Public Information Disclosure Law.

segments.src: ## Risiko dana negara yang perlu dicermati
segments.tr: ## State fund risks to watch out for

segments.src: Setiap investasi mengandung risiko.
segments.tr: Every investment carries risk.

segments.src: Yang perlu dilihat adalah apakah risiko itu dikenali, diukur, dan diungkapkan.
segments.tr: What needs to be seen is whether that risk is identified, measured, and disclosed.

segments.src: Beberapa area yang lazim diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Some areas commonly observed:

segments.src: - **Risiko konsentrasi**: dana terlalu terpusat pada satu sektor atau proyek.
segments.tr: - **Concentration risk**: funds are too concentrated in one sector or project.

segments.src: - **Risiko tata kelola**: keputusan yang dipengaruhi kepentingan non-komersial tanpa kajian yang memadai.
segments.tr: - **Governance risk**: decisions influenced by non-commercial interests without adequate study.

segments.src: - **Risiko likuiditas**: aset sulit dicairkan saat diperlukan.
segments.tr: - **Liquidity risk**: assets are difficult to liquidate when needed.

segments.src: - **Risiko utang dan jaminan**: kewajiban yang akhirnya ditanggung anggaran negara.
segments.tr: - **Debt and guarantee risk**: obligations that are ultimately borne by the state budget.

segments.src: - **Risiko pasar dan nilai tukar**: terutama untuk investasi lintas negara.
segments.tr: - **Market and exchange rate risk**: especially for cross-border investments.

segments.src: - **Risiko reputasi**: dampak pada kepercayaan investor dan peringkat kredit negara.
segments.tr: - **Reputational risk**: impact on investor confidence and the country's credit rating.

segments.src: Risiko bukan berarti larangan berinvestasi.
segments.tr: Risk does not mean a ban on investing.

segments.src: Lembaga yang sehat akan menjelaskan risikonya secara terbuka dan menyiapkan mitigasinya.
segments.tr: A healthy agency will explain its risks openly and prepare mitigations for them.

segments.src: ## Cara praktis warga ikut mengawasi
segments.tr: ## Practical ways for citizens to participate in oversight

segments.src: 1. Baca sumber primer: undang-undang, peraturan pemerintah, dan laporan resmi.
segments.tr: 1. Read primary sources: laws, government regulations, and official reports.

segments.src: 2. Bandingkan pemberitaan dari beberapa media yang berbeda sebelum menyimpulkan.
segments.tr: 2. Compare news coverage from several different media outlets before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: 3. Ikuti kajian lembaga riset, akademisi, dan organisasi masyarakat sipil yang menerbitkan data terbuka.
segments.tr: 3. Follow studies by research institutions, academics, and civil society organizations that publish open data.

segments.src: 4. Gunakan hak atas informasi publik dengan mengajukan permohonan resmi bila data belum tersedia.
segments.tr: 4. Use the right to public information by submitting an official request if data is not yet available.

segments.src: 5. Sampaikan masukan melalui wakil rakyat atau kanal pengaduan resmi.
segments.tr: 5. Provide input through people's representatives or official complaint channels.

segments.src: 6. Waspadai klaim yang terlalu pasti, baik yang sangat memuji maupun yang sangat menyerang, tanpa data pendukung.
segments.tr: 6. Be wary of claims that are too certain, both those that are highly praising and those that are highly attacking, without supporting data.

id-20261029-international-logistics-tran.title: [International Logistics and Transportation #7] The One Sheet of Paper That Decides Who Owns a Container: Understanding the Bill of Lading

segments.src: > Bill of Lading (B/L) adalah dokumen pengangkutan laut dengan tiga fungsi: tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak pengangkutan, dan dokumen kepemilikan. Sea waybill adalah "saudaranya" yang lebih ringkas, tetapi tidak berfungsi sebagai dokumen kepemilikan.
segments.tr: > A Bill of Lading (B/L) is a sea transport document with three functions: receipt for goods, evidence of the contract of carriage, and document of title. A sea waybill is its more concise "sibling," but it does not function as a document of title.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Saat barang dikirim lewat laut, penjual dan pembeli biasanya terpisah ribuan kilometer, dan barangnya berada di tangan pihak ketiga, yaitu perusahaan pelayaran (*carrier*).
segments.tr: When goods are shipped by sea, the seller and buyer are usually thousands of kilometers apart, and the goods are in the hands of a third party, the shipping company (*carrier*).

segments.src: Lalu bagaimana semua pihak tahu barang sudah dimuat, dengan syarat apa barang diangkut, dan siapa yang berhak mengambilnya di pelabuhan tujuan?
segments.tr: So how does everyone know that the goods have been loaded, under what terms they are being carried, and who is entitled to collect them at the destination port?

segments.src: Jawabannya ada di satu dokumen: **Bill of Lading** atau **konosemen**.
segments.tr: The answer lies in one document: the **Bill of Lading** or **konosemen**.

segments.src: B/L diterbitkan oleh carrier (atau agennya) dan punya **tiga fungsi utama**:
segments.tr: The B/L is issued by the carrier (or its agent) and has **three main functions**:

segments.src: 1. **Tanda terima barang (*receipt of goods*)**: carrier mengakui telah menerima barang dengan jumlah, jenis, dan kondisi tertentu.
segments.tr: 1. **Receipt for goods (*receipt of goods*)**: the carrier acknowledges that it has received the goods in a certain quantity, type, and condition.

segments.src: 2. **Bukti kontrak pengangkutan (*evidence of contract of carriage*)**: syarat dan ketentuan pengangkutan biasanya tercetak di balik B/L atau dirujuk di dalamnya.
segments.tr: 2. **Evidence of contract of carriage (*evidence of contract of carriage*)**: the terms and conditions of carriage are usually printed on the back of the B/L or referenced in it.

segments.src: 3. **Dokumen kepemilikan (*document of title*)**: siapa pun yang memegang B/L asli secara sah berhak meminta barang diserahkan. Karena itu B/L bisa "diperjualbelikan" selama barang masih di laut.
segments.tr: 3. **Document of title (*document of title*)**: whoever lawfully holds the original B/L is entitled to demand delivery of the goods. For this reason, a B/L can be "traded" while the goods are still at sea.

segments.src: Fungsi ketiga inilah yang membuat B/L istimewa.
segments.tr: This third function is what makes the B/L special.

segments.src: Biasanya B/L asli diterbitkan dalam satu set, umumnya 3 lembar (*full set*).
segments.tr: Original B/Ls are usually issued as a set, generally 3 originals (*full set*).

segments.src: Begitu satu lembar asli diserahkan untuk mengambil barang, lembar lainnya tidak berlaku lagi.
segments.tr: Once one original is surrendered to collect the goods, the other originals become void.

segments.src: **Jenis-jenis B/L yang perlu dikenal:**
segments.tr: **Types of B/L you should know:**

segments.src: - **Menurut status muat**
segments.tr: - **By shipment status**

segments.src: - *Shipped / On Board B/L*: barang sudah benar-benar dimuat ke kapal. Bank umumnya meminta jenis ini dalam transaksi L/C.
segments.tr: - *Shipped / On Board B/L*: the goods have actually been loaded onto the vessel. Banks generally require this type in L/C transactions.

segments.src: - *Received for Shipment B/L*: barang baru diterima carrier dan belum dimuat. Statusnya bisa diubah menjadi "on board" lewat notasi bertanggal.
segments.tr: - *Received for Shipment B/L*: the carrier has received the goods but they have not yet been loaded. Its status can be changed to "on board" through a dated notation.

segments.src: - **Menurut kondisi barang**
segments.tr: - **By condition of goods**

segments.src: - *Clean B/L*: tidak ada catatan kerusakan.
segments.tr: - *Clean B/L*: no notation of damage.

segments.src: - *Claused / Foul B/L*: ada catatan, misalnya "3 karton basah". Bank biasanya menolak B/L seperti ini.
segments.tr: - *Claused / Foul B/L*: contains a notation, e.g., "3 cartons wet". Banks usually reject B/Ls like this.

segments.src: - **Menurut pihak penerima (*consignee*)**
segments.tr: - **By consignee**

segments.src: - *Straight B/L*: ditujukan kepada penerima bernama tertentu dan pada umumnya tidak bisa dialihkan.
segments.tr: - *Straight B/L*: addressed to a named consignee and generally cannot be transferred.

segments.src: - *Order B/L*: berbunyi "to order" atau "to order of [bank/pengirim]", bisa dialihkan lewat endorsemen. Jenis ini paling umum dalam perdagangan dengan L/C.
segments.tr: - *Order B/L*: reads "to order" or "to order of [bank/shipper]" and can be transferred through endorsement. This is the most common type in L/C trade.

segments.src: - *Bearer B/L*: siapa pun pemegangnya berhak atas barang. Jarang dipakai karena berisiko.
segments.tr: - *Bearer B/L*: whoever holds it is entitled to the goods. Rarely used because of the risk involved.

segments.src: - **Menurut penerbit**
segments.tr: - **By issuer**

segments.src: - *Master B/L*: diterbitkan perusahaan pelayaran.
segments.tr: - *Master B/L*: issued by the shipping company.

segments.src: - *House B/L*: diterbitkan forwarder/NVOCC kepada pengirim, terutama untuk muatan konsolidasi (LCL).
segments.tr: - *House B/L*: issued by a forwarder/NVOCC to the shipper, mainly for consolidated cargo (LCL).

segments.src: **Sea Waybill** adalah dokumen pengangkutan laut yang juga berfungsi sebagai tanda terima dan bukti kontrak, tetapi **bukan dokumen kepemilikan** dan tidak dapat dinegosiasikan.
segments.tr: **Sea Waybill** is a sea transport document that also functions as a receipt and evidence of contract, but it is **not a document of title** and is not negotiable.

segments.src: Penerima cukup membuktikan bahwa dialah consignee yang tercantum, tanpa harus menyerahkan dokumen asli.
segments.tr: The consignee only needs to prove that it is the named consignee, without surrendering an original document.

segments.src: Hasilnya, barang bisa diambil lebih cepat.
segments.tr: As a result, goods can be collected faster.

segments.src: Sea waybill cocok untuk pengiriman antar-perusahaan dalam satu grup atau antar-mitra yang sudah saling percaya, dan kurang cocok untuk transaksi yang butuh jaminan bank.
segments.tr: A sea waybill suits shipments between companies in the same group or between partners who already trust each other, and is less suitable for transactions that require bank guarantees.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bayangkan CV Kopi Nusantara di Surabaya mengekspor satu kontainer 20 kaki berisi biji kopi ke pembeli di Rotterdam, senilai sekitar Rp1,5 miliar.
segments.tr: Imagine CV Kopi Nusantara in Surabaya exporting one 20-foot container of coffee beans to a buyer in Rotterdam, worth about Rp1.5 billion.

segments.src: Pembayarannya memakai L/C.
segments.tr: Payment is made using an L/C.

segments.src: Kontainer dimuat di Pelabuhan Tanjung Perak.
segments.tr: The container is loaded at Tanjung Perak Port.

segments.src: Perusahaan pelayaran lalu menerbitkan **Shipped, Clean, Order B/L** dalam 3 lembar asli.
segments.tr: The shipping company then issues a **Shipped, Clean, Order B/L** in 3 originals.

segments.src: CV Kopi Nusantara menyerahkan B/L beserta invoice dan packing list ke bank di Surabaya.
segments.tr: CV Kopi Nusantara submits the B/L together with the invoice and packing list to a bank in Surabaya.

segments.src: Dokumen itu dikirim ke bank pembeli di Belanda, dan pembeli baru memperoleh B/L asli setelah membayar atau menyetujui pembayaran.
segments.tr: The documents are sent to the buyer's bank in the Netherlands, and the buyer obtains the original B/L only after paying or agreeing to pay.

segments.src: Selama kapal berlayar sekitar 4–5 minggu, B/L itulah "kunci" kontainer kopi tersebut.
segments.tr: During the ship's voyage of about 4–5 weeks, the B/L is the "key" to the coffee container.

segments.src: Tanpa B/L asli, pembeli tidak bisa mengambil barang di Rotterdam.
segments.tr: Without the original B/L, the buyer cannot collect the goods in Rotterdam.

segments.src: Sekarang bandingkan dengan pengiriman suku cadang dari pabrik di Cikarang ke anak perusahaannya sendiri di Singapura.
segments.tr: Now compare this with shipping spare parts from a factory in Cikarang to its own subsidiary in Singapore.

segments.src: Karena masih satu grup dan tidak memakai L/C, pengirim cukup memakai **sea waybill**.
segments.tr: Since both companies are in the same group and no L/C is used, the shipper only needs a **sea waybill**.

segments.src: Begitu kapal tiba, anak perusahaan langsung mengambil barang tanpa menunggu kiriman dokumen asli lewat kurir.
segments.tr: Once the ship arrives, the subsidiary collects the goods right away, without waiting for the original documents to arrive by courier.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. B/L punya tiga fungsi: tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak pengangkutan, dan dokumen kepemilikan.
segments.tr: 1. A B/L has three functions: receipt for goods, evidence of contract of carriage, and document of title.

segments.src: 2. Jenis B/L dibedakan berdasarkan status muat (shipped/received), kondisi barang (clean/claused), penerima (straight/order/bearer), dan penerbit (master/house).
segments.tr: 2. B/L types are distinguished by shipment status (shipped/received), condition of goods (clean/claused), consignee (straight/order/bearer), and issuer (master/house).

segments.src: 3. Sea waybill lebih cepat dan praktis, tetapi bukan dokumen kepemilikan, jadi cocok untuk mitra yang sudah saling percaya.
segments.tr: 3. A sea waybill is faster and more practical, but it is not a document of title, so it suits partners who already trust each other.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Fungsi B/L yang memungkinkan barang "dijual" selama masih berada di kapal adalah …
segments.tr: **1.** The B/L function that allows goods to be "sold" while they are still on the ship is …

segments.src: a) Tanda terima barang
segments.tr: a) Receipt for goods

segments.src: b) Bukti kontrak pengangkutan
segments.tr: b) Evidence of contract of carriage

segments.src: c) Dokumen kepemilikan
segments.tr: c) Document of title

segments.src: d) Daftar muatan kapal
segments.tr: d) Ship's cargo manifest

segments.src: **2.** O/X: B/L yang memuat catatan "5 karung sobek" disebut *clean B/L*.
segments.tr: **2.** True/False: a B/L bearing the notation "5 sacks torn" is called a *clean B/L*.

segments.src: **3.** Mana pernyataan yang benar tentang sea waybill?
segments.tr: **3.** Which statement about a sea waybill is correct?

segments.src: a) Harus diserahkan dalam bentuk asli untuk mengambil barang
segments.tr: a) It must be surrendered in original form to collect the goods

segments.src: b) Merupakan dokumen kepemilikan yang dapat diendorse
segments.tr: b) It is a negotiable document of title that can be endorsed

segments.src: c) Bukan dokumen kepemilikan, dan penerima cukup membuktikan identitasnya sebagai consignee
segments.tr: c) It is not a document of title, and the consignee only needs to prove its identity as consignee

segments.src: d) Hanya boleh diterbitkan oleh bank
segments.tr: d) It may only be issued by a bank

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Bill of Lading (B/L) / Konosemen**: dokumen dari carrier yang menjadi tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak pengangkutan, dan dokumen kepemilikan.
segments.tr: - **Bill of Lading (B/L) / Konosemen**: a document from the carrier that serves as receipt for goods, evidence of contract of carriage, and document of title.

segments.src: - **Consignee**: pihak penerima barang yang tercantum dalam dokumen pengangkutan.
segments.tr: - **Consignee**: the party receiving the goods, as named in the transport document.

segments.src: - **Order B/L**: B/L "to order" yang hak atas barangnya dapat dialihkan melalui endorsemen.
segments.tr: - **Order B/L**: a "to order" B/L whose right to the goods can be transferred through endorsement.

segments.src: - **Clean B/L**: B/L tanpa catatan kerusakan atau kekurangan barang.
segments.tr: - **Clean B/L**: a B/L with no notation of damage or shortage of goods.

segments.src: - **Sea Waybill**: dokumen pengangkutan laut yang tidak dapat dinegosiasikan dan bukan dokumen kepemilikan, sehingga barang bisa diambil tanpa menyerahkan dokumen asli.
segments.tr: - **Sea Waybill**: a sea transport document that is non-negotiable and not a document of title, so goods can be collected without surrendering an original document.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) c.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) c.

segments.src: Karena B/L adalah dokumen kepemilikan, menyerahkan B/L berarti mengalihkan hak untuk mengambil barang.
segments.tr: Because the B/L is a document of title, surrendering it means transferring the right to collect the goods.

segments.src: B/L dengan catatan kerusakan disebut claused atau foul B/L, dan bank umumnya menolaknya.
segments.tr: A B/L with a notation of damage is called a claused or foul B/L, and banks generally reject it.

segments.src: Sea waybill tidak perlu diserahkan dalam bentuk asli, sehingga pengambilan barang lebih cepat, tetapi tidak berfungsi sebagai jaminan kepemilikan.*
segments.tr: A sea waybill does not need to be surrendered in original form, so goods can be collected faster, but it does not serve as proof of ownership.*

id-20261029-news-1.title: BI-Rate Hikes and Mortgage Installments: How to Interpret Them for Borrowers and Savers

segments.src: Ketika Bank Indonesia (BI) menaikkan suku bunga acuan atau BI-Rate pada 2026 untuk menahan tekanan pelemahan rupiah, dampaknya tidak berhenti di ruang rapat bank sentral.
segments.tr: When Bank Indonesia (BI) raises the benchmark interest rate or BI-Rate in 2026 to curb pressure from a weakening rupiah, the impact does not stop at the central bank's boardroom.

segments.src: Keputusan itu pelan-pelan merembet ke bunga kredit, cicilan KPR, hingga imbal hasil deposito.
segments.tr: That decision slowly trickles down to loan interest rates, mortgage installments, and deposit yields.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan mekanismenya dengan bahasa sederhana, lalu merangkum langkah yang bisa dipertimbangkan rumah tangga.
segments.tr: This article explains the mechanism in simple language and summarizes steps that households can consider.

segments.src: > Catatan: artikel ini bersifat edukatif dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau ajakan membeli produk tertentu. Angka dalam contoh hanya ilustrasi. Untuk keputusan pribadi, periksa ketentuan di perjanjian Anda dan konsultasikan dengan bank atau perencana keuangan berlisensi.
segments.tr: > Note: This article is educational and is not financial advice or an invitation to purchase specific products. The figures in the examples are for illustration only. For personal decisions, check the terms in your agreement and consult with your bank or a licensed financial planner.

segments.src: ## Apa itu BI-Rate dan mengapa dinaikkan?
segments.tr: ## What is the BI-Rate and why is it raised?

segments.src: BI-Rate adalah suku bunga kebijakan yang menjadi sinyal arah moneter BI.
segments.tr: The BI-Rate is the policy interest rate that serves as a signal for BI's monetary direction.

segments.src: Salah satu tujuan utama BI adalah menjaga stabilitas nilai rupiah, baik terhadap barang dan jasa (inflasi) maupun terhadap mata uang asing.
segments.tr: One of BI's main goals is to maintain the stability of the rupiah's value, both against goods and services (inflation) and against foreign currencies.

segments.src: Saat rupiah melemah tajam, harga barang impor, bahan baku, dan utang luar negeri dalam rupiah ikut terdorong naik.
segments.tr: When the rupiah weakens sharply, the prices of imported goods, raw materials, and foreign debt denominated in rupiah are pushed higher.

segments.src: Dengan menaikkan BI-Rate, BI membuat aset rupiah lebih menarik bagi investor.
segments.tr: By raising the BI-Rate, BI makes rupiah assets more attractive to investors.

segments.src: Aliran modal keluar diharapkan mereda dan nilai tukar lebih stabil.
segments.tr: Capital outflows are expected to ease, and the exchange rate becomes more stable.

segments.src: Kenaikan suku bunga memang punya harga, yaitu biaya pinjaman yang cenderung naik dan pertumbuhan kredit yang bisa melambat.
segments.tr: An interest rate hike does come at a cost, namely that borrowing costs tend to rise and credit growth may slow down.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana BI-Rate menjalar ke bunga kredit dan deposito?
segments.tr: ## How does the BI-Rate propagate to loan and deposit interest rates?

segments.src: Jalur penjalaran ini disebut transmisi kebijakan moneter.
segments.tr: This propagation path is called monetary policy transmission.

segments.src: Secara ringkas:
segments.tr: In summary:

segments.src: 1. **BI-Rate naik**, sehingga suku bunga pasar uang antarbank ikut naik.
segments.tr: 1. **BI-Rate rises**, so interbank money market interest rates also rise.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya dana bank naik.** Bank bersaing mendapat dana pihak ketiga, sehingga bunga deposito dan tabungan cenderung ikut terdongkrak.
segments.tr: 2. **Bank funding costs rise.** Banks compete for third-party funds, so deposit and savings interest rates tend to be pushed up as well.

segments.src: 3. **Bunga kredit menyesuaikan.** Bank menambahkan margin untuk risiko dan biaya operasional di atas biaya dana, sehingga bunga kredit bisa naik.
segments.tr: 3. **Loan interest rates adjust.** Banks add a margin for risk and operational costs on top of funding costs, so loan interest rates can rise.

segments.src: Penjalarannya tidak seragam dan tidak instan.
segments.tr: The propagation is not uniform and not instantaneous.

segments.src: Bunga deposito biasanya bergerak lebih dulu dan lebih cepat daripada bunga kredit.
segments.tr: Deposit interest rates usually move first and faster than loan interest rates.

segments.src: Bunga kredit sering lebih lambat turun daripada naik, karena bank mempertimbangkan kondisi likuiditas dan kualitas kredit masing-masing.
segments.tr: Loan interest rates are often slower to fall than to rise, because banks consider their liquidity conditions and individual credit quality.

segments.src: Lamanya jeda juga berbeda antar bank.
segments.tr: The length of the lag also differs between banks.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke KPR: tergantung jenis bunganya
segments.tr: ## Impact on mortgages: depends on the interest rate type

segments.src: Hal terpenting bagi debitur adalah **jenis bunga KPR** yang tercantum di perjanjian.
segments.tr: The most important thing for a borrower is the **type of mortgage interest rate** stated in the agreement.

segments.src: - **Bunga tetap (fixed) selama periode tertentu.** Pada masa ini cicilan tidak berubah meski BI-Rate naik. Risikonya muncul setelah masa fixed berakhir, ketika bunga beralih ke skema mengambang.
segments.tr: - **Fixed interest rate for a certain period.** During this time, installments do not change even if the BI-Rate rises. The risk arises after the fixed period ends, when the interest rate switches to a floating scheme.

segments.src: - **Bunga mengambang (floating).** Cicilan bisa naik mengikuti suku bunga dasar kredit bank, biasanya setelah pemberitahuan resmi dari bank.
segments.tr: - **Floating interest rate.** Installments can rise following the bank's base lending rate, usually after an official notification from the bank.

segments.src: - **Skema campuran.** Banyak KPR memakai fixed beberapa tahun pertama, kemudian floating. Periksa kapan peralihan terjadi.
segments.tr: - **Mixed scheme.** Many mortgages use a fixed rate for the first few years, then switch to floating. Check when the transition occurs.

segments.src: ### Contoh ilustrasi
segments.tr: ### Illustrative example

segments.src: Misalkan pinjaman Rp500 juta dengan tenor 20 tahun, cicilan anuitas bulanan:
segments.tr: Suppose a loan of Rp500 million with a 20-year tenor, monthly annuity installments:

segments.src: | Bunga per tahun | Perkiraan cicilan per bulan |
segments.tr: | Interest per year | Estimated monthly installment |

segments.src: | 8% | sekitar Rp4,18 juta |
segments.tr: | 8% | around Rp4.18 million |

segments.src: | 9% | sekitar Rp4,50 juta |
segments.tr: | 9% | around Rp4.50 million |

segments.src: Kenaikan bunga satu poin persentase menambah cicilan sekitar Rp300 ribu lebih per bulan, atau sekitar 7 sampai 8 persen.
segments.tr: A one percentage point interest rate hike increases the installment by about Rp300 thousand more per month, or about 7 to 8 percent.

segments.src: Bagi rumah tangga dengan anggaran ketat, selisih ini cukup terasa.
segments.tr: For households with tight budgets, this difference is quite noticeable.

segments.src: Angka di atas hanya perhitungan matematis sederhana, bukan penawaran bank mana pun.
segments.tr: The figures above are just simple mathematical calculations, not an offer from any bank.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke penabung dan deposan
segments.tr: ## Impact on savers and depositors

segments.src: Bagi penabung, kenaikan suku bunga umumnya kabar yang lebih menyenangkan, dengan beberapa catatan:
segments.tr: For savers, interest rate hikes are generally better news, with a few notes:

segments.src: - Bunga deposito baru cenderung naik, tetapi deposito yang sedang berjalan biasanya tetap memakai bunga saat penempatan.
segments.tr: - New deposit interest rates tend to rise, but ongoing deposits usually continue to use the interest rate at the time of placement.

segments.src: - Bunga tabungan biasa naik lebih lambat dan lebih kecil dibandingkan deposito.
segments.tr: - Regular savings interest rates rise slower and by less compared to deposits.

segments.src: - Imbal hasil riil tetap harus dihitung setelah inflasi dan pajak atas bunga. Bunga yang naik belum tentu berarti daya beli bertambah jika harga-harga juga naik.
segments.tr: - Real yields must still be calculated after inflation and taxes on interest. Higher interest does not necessarily mean increased purchasing power if prices are also rising.

segments.src: - Simpanan di bank anggota Lembaga Penjamin Simpanan (LPS) dijamin sampai batas dan syarat tertentu. Periksa ketentuan terbaru LPS, termasuk batas bunga penjaminan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: - Deposits in banks that are members of the Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation (LPS) are guaranteed up to certain limits and conditions. Check the latest LPS provisions, including the applicable guaranteed interest rate limits.

segments.src: ## Langkah praktis untuk rumah tangga
segments.tr: ## Practical steps for households

segments.src: ### Bagi yang memiliki KPR atau kredit lain
segments.tr: ### For those with a mortgage or other loans

segments.src: 1. **Cek perjanjian kredit.** Catat jenis bunga, tanggal berakhirnya masa fixed, dan aturan penalti pelunasan sebagian atau penuh.
segments.tr: 1. **Check your loan agreement.** Note the interest rate type, the end date of the fixed period, and the rules for partial or full early repayment penalties.

segments.src: 2. **Hitung ulang anggaran.** Simulasikan cicilan jika bunga naik 1 sampai 2 poin persentase, lalu pastikan total cicilan utang masih wajar terhadap penghasilan. Banyak perencana keuangan menyarankan agar total cicilan tidak melebihi sekitar sepertiga penghasilan.
segments.tr: 2. **Recalculate your budget.** Simulate installments if the interest rate rises by 1 to 2 percentage points, then ensure the total debt installment is still reasonable relative to your income. Many financial planners suggest that total installments should not exceed about one-third of your income.

segments.src: 3. **Pertimbangkan pembayaran ekstra.** Jika ada kelebihan dana, pelunasan sebagian pokok dapat memangkas total bunga. Pastikan dulu tidak ada biaya yang membuatnya tidak sepadan.
segments.tr: 3. **Consider extra payments.** If you have excess funds, partial principal repayment can cut total interest. First, ensure there are no fees that make it not worth it.

segments.src: 4. **Bandingkan opsi refinancing dengan hati-hati.** Pindah ke bank lain atau negosiasi ulang bisa menekan bunga, tetapi ada biaya provisi, appraisal, dan administrasi. Hitung titik impasnya sebelum memutuskan.
segments.tr: 4. **Compare refinancing options carefully.** Moving to another bank or renegotiating can lower interest rates, but there are provision, appraisal, and administrative fees. Calculate the break-even point before deciding.

segments.src: 5. **Pertahankan dana darurat.** Dana darurat setara beberapa bulan pengeluaran membantu Anda tetap membayar cicilan saat pendapatan terganggu.
segments.tr: 5. **Maintain an emergency fund.** An emergency fund equivalent to several months of expenses helps you keep paying installments when your income is disrupted.

segments.src: ### Bagi calon pembeli rumah
segments.tr: ### For prospective homebuyers

segments.src: - Tanyakan simulasi cicilan untuk beberapa skenario bunga, bukan hanya bunga promosi di tahun pertama.
segments.tr: - Ask for installment simulations for several interest rate scenarios, not just the promotional rate in the first year.

segments.src: - Perhatikan masa fixed, bunga setelahnya, biaya notaris, pajak, dan uang muka.
segments.tr: - Pay attention to the fixed period, the subsequent interest rate, notary fees, taxes, and the down payment.

segments.src: - Jangan memaksakan plafon maksimum yang disetujui bank. Pilih angka yang nyaman bagi arus kas Anda sendiri.
segments.tr: - Do not force the maximum ceiling approved by the bank. Choose a number that is comfortable for your own cash flow.

segments.src: ### Bagi penabung
segments.tr: ### For savers

segments.src: - Bandingkan bunga deposito antar bank yang terdaftar dan diawasi OJK, dan perhatikan tenor serta aturan pencairan lebih awal.
segments.tr: - Compare deposit interest rates between banks registered and supervised by the OJK, and pay attention to the tenor and rules for early withdrawal.

segments.src: - Hindari mengunci seluruh dana dalam satu tenor panjang. Membagi dana ke beberapa tenor memberi fleksibilitas jika suku bunga bergerak lagi.
segments.tr: - Avoid locking all funds into one long tenor. Dividing funds into several tenors provides flexibility if interest rates move again.

segments.src: - Waspadai tawaran bunga yang jauh di atas rata-rata pasar. Imbal hasil tinggi tanpa penjelasan jelas sering menandakan risiko tinggi.
segments.tr: - Be wary of interest offers that are far above the market average. High yields without a clear explanation often signal high risk.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca arah ke depan
segments.tr: ## How to read the future direction

segments.src: BI-Rate bukan angka yang berjalan satu arah selamanya.
segments.tr: The BI-Rate is not a number that moves in one direction forever.

segments.src: Keputusannya dipengaruhi inflasi, nilai tukar, kebijakan bank sentral negara besar, dan kondisi ekonomi global.
segments.tr: Its decisions are influenced by inflation, exchange rates, the policies of central banks in major countries, and global economic conditions.

segments.src: Pantau pengumuman Rapat Dewan Gubernur BI yang dipublikasikan di situs resmi bank sentral, lalu bandingkan dengan pemberitahuan bank tempat Anda memiliki kredit atau simpanan.
segments.tr: Monitor the announcements of the BI Board of Governors Meeting published on the central bank's official website, then compare them with notifications from the bank where you have a loan or savings.

segments.src: Intinya, kenaikan BI-Rate adalah sinyal untuk meninjau ulang keuangan, bukan alasan untuk panik.
segments.tr: In essence, a BI-Rate hike is a signal to review your finances, not a reason to panic.

segments.src: Debitur perlu memahami jenis bunga dan menyiapkan ruang anggaran, sedangkan penabung perlu menilai imbal hasil setelah inflasi dan pajak.
segments.tr: Borrowers need to understand the interest rate type and prepare budget room, while savers need to assess yields after inflation and taxes.

segments.src: Keputusan yang tenang dan berbasis data hampir selalu lebih baik daripada keputusan yang diambil karena takut ketinggalan atau takut rugi.
segments.tr: Calm, data-driven decisions are almost always better than decisions made out of fear of missing out or fear of loss.
